send: date -Is; hostname   # this machine: the exe.dev VM
ssh -t sdfiana025 bash --rcfile $R/logs/proof45/rc.sh -i
hostname; date '+%F %T %Z'; echo "S=$S"; echo "SG=$SG"
# every node command below is its own Slurm step on sdfada013 ($S; $SG also holds the node's GPU); each DAQ up..down holds the node lock
git fetch -q origin && git merge origin/agentify; git rev-parse HEAD; git log -1 --format='%s' | cut -c1-138; echo "local changes: $(git status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
git log --format='%h %s' 5b1f5587d..HEAD | cut -c1-138
git diff --stat 5b1f5587d HEAD | tail -1; git diff --stat=138 5b1f5587d HEAD -- psdaq/drp psdaq/drpGpu psana | cut -c1-138
# The node has no CUDA toolkit; the builds use conda-forge's 12.9 and 13.3, installed in the project's scratch (a GPU step, for nvidia-smi)
$SG bash $L/toolkit.sh
# GreenCtxCompat.hh (1cd736f07), preprocessed under each toolkit: with CUDA 12.9 it maps the green contexts onto the driver API; with 13.3 it adds nothing
$S bash $L/compat.sh
export P=$L/take1; mkdir -p $P/ev; echo "records in $P/ev: $(ls -A $P/ev | wc -l); work dirs in $P: $(ls -d $P/wd-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
# Build at this HEAD, fresh (build_all.sh -f -d): CUDA 12.9 here (the runs below use it), then CUDA 13.3 in wt-gpu-cuda13 at the same HEAD
$S bash $L/build.sh wt-gpu 12.9
git -C $R/wt-gpu-cuda13 rev-parse --short HEAD; echo "wt-gpu-cuda13 local changes: $(git -C $R/wt-gpu-cuda13 status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
$S bash $L/build.sh wt-gpu-cuda13 13.3
# CUDA 13.3 compiles only: this node's driver (575) runs CUDA 12.9 at most, so every run below uses the 12.9 build
# At the base 5b1f5587d (worktree wt-nb45) drpGpu does not configure on this node with either toolkit: its meson.build hard-codes /usr/local/cuda
git -C $R/wt-nb45 log -1 --format='wt-nb45 %h %s' | cut -c1-138; echo "wt-nb45 local changes: $(git -C $R/wt-nb45 status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
for v in 12.9 13.3; do $S bash $L/basemeson.sh wt-nb45 $v; done
# The CI (Test DAQ) builds with ./build_all.sh -d and no nvcc, so meson skips psdaq/drpGpu; the same fresh build at base (wt-nb45) and at this HEAD (wt-nh45)
grep -n 'build_all' .github/workflows/run_daq_tests.yaml | cut -c1-138; git -C $R/wt-nh45 rev-parse --short HEAD
$S bash $L/build.sh wt-nb45 none
$S bash $L/build.sh wt-nh45 none
$S bash $L/nocuda.sh wt-nb45 wt-nh45

grep -n -E '^if |^endif' psdaq/drpGpu/meson.build; git diff -U0 5b1f5587d HEAD -- psdaq/drpGpu/meson.build | grep '^@@'; git diff --stat 5b1f5587d HEAD -- '*meson.build' meson_options.txt build_all.sh
# The sim unit tests at this HEAD (one step, node lock)
$S bash $L/pytest.sh
# Each GPU type on a fresh simulated DAQ in one GPU step: up --det <type> --drp drp_gpu, cycle --events 1000, down; its drp_gpu log;
# xtc2_check --drp drp_gpu on the file (every pixel of every event: as written must PASS, --self-test-offset 1 must FAIL)
# fakecam: Gpu::AreaDetector, configured by xpmdet_config as drp -D fakecam is; then a fault run: TDetSemi.Length_0 reads back wrong
$SG bash $L/gpurun.sh fakecam $P DrpTDet.PcieControl.DevPcie.TDetSemi.Length_0
# epixuhremu: Gpu::EpixUHRemu, configured by epixuhremu_configTiming and xpmdet_config; the same fault run
$SG bash $L/gpurun.sh epixuhremu $P DrpTDet.PcieControl.DevPcie.TDetSemi.Length_0
# epixuhrsim: Gpu::EpixUHRsim, its SimDetector's 16 frames timed by simxpm; checked against the frames and constants it writes (sim_ref)
$SG bash $L/gpurun.sh epixuhrsim $P
# 695b1b2ee (AreaDetector: pedestals 0 and gains 1, not null pointers): the same command at a base without it and at this HEAD.
# Base: wt-gpu-r695 = this HEAD with 695b1b2ee reverted (4bde760d1, detached, not on any branch), built with CUDA 12.9 before the recording

git -C $R/wt-gpu-r695 log -2 --format='%h %s' | cut -c1-138; git -C $R/wt-gpu-r695 diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD | tail -1; echo "local changes: $(git -C $R/wt-gpu-r695 status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
grep -E '^build|^nvcc on|^BUILD_EXIT' $L/prebuild.log | grep -A2 wt-gpu-r695 | sed "s#$R#\$R#g" | cut -c1-138; ninja -C $R/wt-gpu-r695/builddir -n | tail -1
for w in wt-gpu-r695 wt-gpu; do $SG bash $L/fix695.sh $w $P; done
# The CPU DRP's 14 types of PRs #34, #36 and #39 at this HEAD (XpmDetector and BEBDetector now reach MemPoolSim through MemPool::sim()):
# one step, each type on a fresh DAQ under the node lock: up --det <type>, cycle --events 1000, down, then xtc2_check as written and with the offset
$S bash $L/cputypes.sh $P opal piranha4 tb epixquad fakecam cspad epixhremu jungfrauemu ts hrencoder epixm320 epix100 wave8 wave8he
# daq_sim coverage at this HEAD over the 17 records (3 drp_gpu, 14 drp)
$S bash $L/cov.sh $P
grep -E '^det:drp_gpu:|^prog:(control|drp|drp_gpu|teb|pyxpm) ' $P/cov.txt | cut -c1-138
echo "det rows RUN: $(grep -cE '^det:[a-z_]+:[A-Za-z0-9]+ +RUN +evidence' $P/cov.txt)"; grep -E '^[0-9]+ rows|^status file|^(PASS|FAIL)' $P/cov.txt | cut -c1-138
# Negatives: (1) the drp_gpu fakecam record left out, the CPU drp's fakecam record kept: det:drp_gpu:fakecam must drop;
# (2) also a copy of that drp record with its rows renamed to det:drp_gpu:fakecam and prog:drp_gpu: a drp record must not prove a drp_gpu row
$S bash $L/neg.sh $P
for t in no-gpu-fakecam forged; do echo "== cov-$t.txt"; grep -E '^det:drp(_gpu)?:fakecam |^[0-9]+ rows|^(PASS|FAIL)|^  det:' $P/cov-$t.txt | sed "s#$P/##g" | fold -w 138; done
# The hardware path (no sim:// device) of what this PR changes, from base and head builds, the same commands (hwpath.sh), GPU step, node lock.
# (a) drp_gpu and drp from the CUDA 12.9 builds of 1cd736f07 (wt-gpu-base: this PR's first commit, the oldest drpGpu that builds here) and this HEAD

git -C $R/wt-gpu-base log -1 --format='wt-gpu-base %h %s' | cut -c1-138; echo "local changes: $(git -C $R/wt-gpu-base status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"; ninja -C $R/wt-gpu-base/builddir -n | tail -1
$SG bash $L/hwrun.sh $P wt-gpu-base wt-gpu cuda
grep -E '^-- |^rc=' $P/hw-wt-gpu.log | cut -c1-138
grep -A9 -E '^-- drp_gpu .*epixuhrsim' $P/hw-wt-gpu.log | grep -E 'Built with|SM resources|Ready|rc=' | cut -c1-138
# (b) drp and psana from the no-CUDA builds (as CI builds) of base 5b1f5587d (wt-nb45) and this HEAD (wt-nh45)
$S bash $L/hwrun.sh $P wt-nb45 wt-nh45 nocuda
cat $P/hw-diff-nocuda.txt | cut -c1-138; grep -E '^-- |^rc=|^(fakecam|epixhremu|epix100): ' $P/hw-wt-nh45.log | cut -c1-138
echo "local changes: $(git status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"; git rev-parse HEAD; date '+%F %T %Z'
exit
